name: Jojo Game
description: A fast-paced 2D JoJo-themed stickman fighting game featuring Jotaro, DIO, Josuke, Diavolo, Polnareff, Jonathan, Joseph, Tooru, Enrico Pucci, Funny Valentine (D4C, Love Train), Dipez (Pure Light Form), Arabian Fat (The Sun), and Michael Junister (Ghost: Hat Price & Golden Kinetic Martial Arts).
